They are stronger, more resilient variants of [[Moblin]]s, and they are known to carry the stronger [[Moblin Gear]] or other [[Weapon]]s. When defeated, they drop [[Moblin Horn]]s, [[Moblin Fang]]s, and [[Moblin Guts]]. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Black Moblin |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Moblin Guts | 1 | 100 % |- | Moblin Fang | 3-4 | 100 % |- | Moblin Horn | 1 | 100 % }} |- | FireArrow | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Fire Arrow x5 | 1-2 | 40 % |- | Moblin Fang | 1-2 | 60 % |- | Moblin Horn | 1 | 100 % |- | Moblin Guts | 1

| 100 % }} }} }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Black Moblin}} Black Moblins reappear in {{TotK}}, acting similarly to how they did in {{BotW}}. They have new [[Black Moblin Horn]]s, which they slam into the ground while attacking. It is possible to encounter [[Gloom-Wreathed Enemy|Gloom-Wreathed]] variants of Black Moblins. ==Other Appearances== ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:CoH Black Moblin Sprite.png|left]] Black Moblins are stronger than [[Red Moblin]]s, possessing more health and attack power, along with having more powerful spears that they can throw at [[Cadence]], [[Link]], [[Yves]], and [[Zelda]]. They move to the beat of the music and share the same beat pattern as the other [[Moblin]]s, moving on every other beat, having to crouch for one beat before hopping to an adjacent tile on the second beat. When they're close enough, they will throw a spear at the heroes, stopping on one beat to aim, throwing it on the second, and letting it land on the third beat. Afterwards, they will try to retrieve their weapon until it is either destroyed or picked up by another Moblin or even the hero if they are using the [[Power Glove]]. Once they lose their spear, they will try to look for another one or if there are none, try to attack the heroes head on. Their spears are the second-strongest, dealing 3 [[Heart]]s of damage to any enemy that get hit by them, being second to only the [[Purple Moblin]] spear in terms of power. During the events of [[Symphony of the Mask (Mode)|Symphony of the Mask]], Black Skull Moblins appear but otherwise act the same as in the main game. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} Black Moblins reappear as [[Powerful Foe]]s in {{AoC}}, first appearing in the [[Scenario]] "[[The Road Home, Besieged]]". During certain [[Challenge]]s added in the {{PotA}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack, some carry containers holding [[Bomb Barrel]]s on their backs. A variant utilizing [[Sky Octorok]]s appears during the [[Scenario]] "[[EX Liberate the Ancient Lab]]". Two Black Moblins are also absorbed by [[Harbinger Ganon]] to recover its health after taking a beating from [[Terrako]]. Defeated Black Moblins most often drop [[Moblin Fang]]s and [[Moblin Horn|Horns]], but may also rarely drop [[Moblin Guts]]. Slaying one awards a [[Moblin Trophy]] at the end of a [[Battle]]. A [[Treasure Chest]] containing a [[Weapon]] may also appear. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Stub|AoI}} Black Moblins can be encountered as [[Powerful Enemy|Powerful Enemies]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Moblin Concept Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept art of Moblins File:TotK Black Moblin Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Gloom-Wreathed Black Moblin File:CoH Spear Sprite 4.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}A Spear thrown by a Black Moblin ==See Also== {{See Also| * Enemy * Moblin * Monster }} {{Ref| {{Cite|'''Black Moblin'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite|These heavyweight monsters can be found all over Hyrule and are among the most dangerous types of Moblin.
